inventoryAndTiming.title: CP-006/R6 independent nonempty selected inventory is executed exactly once with complete phase measurements
assertions: longest shard and critical path measured

liveInput.evidenceRoot: absolute canonical owned root containing this plan and every original observation artifact
liveInput.sourceRoot: absolute original checkout root used only to normalize selected test identities

current.invocation: independently assigned identity of the immediately completed validation
current.sourceSha256: independently frozen lowercase SHA256 of its source identity manifest
current.startedAt: original validation start in epoch milliseconds
current.finishedAt: original validation completion in epoch milliseconds

liveInput.inventory: {file: relative artifact path, sha256: original lowercase SHA256}; artifact has invocation, sourceSha256, collectedAt and cases:[{file,fullName}]
liveInput.observations: {file: relative artifact path, sha256: original lowercase SHA256}; artifact has invocation, sourceSha256, startedAt, finishedAt, phases, commands and measurements
liveInput.reports: one {file: relative artifact path, sha256: original lowercase SHA256} per original shard; unmodified generic Vitest JSON reports
liveInput.phases: build/setup/run/teardown/leak each {startedAt,finishedAt}; ordered measured intervals inside the original invocation
liveInput.commands: every actual subprocess {phase,argv,startedAt,finishedAt,exitCode,signal}; each run also references its report path; exactly one build
liveInput.measurements: buildMs/setupMs/runMs/teardownMs/leakMs/totalMs/longestShardMs/criticalPathMs, all original integer milliseconds checked against observed intervals
liveInput.criticalPath: full elapsed span from the one original build through setup, overlapping shards, teardown and final leak check, including inter-phase waits
liveInput.longestShard: maximum original run-command elapsed interval; runMs spans earliest shard start through latest shard completion
liveInput.completeness: expected identities come only from the independent inventory collected before execution; original report fullName plus file must reproduce them exactly once
liveInput.qualification: root preserves original artifacts and hashes; supplied passing booleans cannot replace individual results, summaries, successful actual exits or measured intervals
liveInput.circularity: completed selection must exclude the currently executing CP-006/R6 reference
liveInput.safety: no commands launched; bounded ordinary artifact files inside declared canonical owned root; no unrelated file reads
